verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a documented public Developer API. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec with 174 paths, alongside plain-text llms.txt API references, OAuth 2.0 with granular scopes and multiple grant types, a sandbox at demo-api.ramp.com, and webhooks. Guides cover transactions, bills and banking endpoints, and the index gives explicit agent-oriented usage instructions. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of building against the API.
